'''Oponni Narthrup''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Narthrup was stationed at the [[Vergesso Base]], acting as the general administrator of the Alliance in the [[Lybeya system/Legends|Lybeya system]].
==Biography==
Oponni Narthrup joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In her early life, she broke her long periods of boring work with intense adventure, which granted her a wide area of experiences and skills.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Thanks to her multidisciplinary background, she was too valuable an officer to be wasted in the battlefield. She was transferred to the [[Vergesso Base]]] [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]], located in the [[Vergesso Asteroids/Legends|Vergesso Asteroids]], where she acted as the general administrator of the Rebel personnel in the system, as well as the Alliance liaison with [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Ororo Transportation]] that owned the installation.<ref name="guide" />
==Personality and traits==
Narthrup boasted many talents and skills and in her early thirties she had rich experiences, considered a well-rounded, flexible officer, able to be work in several roles, such as liaison work. The [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] avoided to use her a line officer and chose the right assignments for her.<ref name="guide" />

She was thin with blue eyes and used to tie her blonde hair in a loose ponytail. She had a ready smile and positive disposition, which made her stand out among the grim [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] that populated Vergesso.<ref name="guide" />

She preferred to wear [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuits]] with medium shade primary colors.<ref name="guide" />
